question: Who among the following personalities was the recipient of the Lata Mangeshkar Award for Music 2021, presented by the Madhya Pradesh government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumar Sanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kumar Sanu, a renowned playback singer in Indian cinema, was honored with the prestigious **Lata Mangeshkar Award for Music 2021** by the Madhya Pradesh government.
 
• The award recognizes excellence in the field of music and is named after the legendary singer **Lata Mangeshkar**, known as the "Nightingale of India."
 
• The Madhya Pradesh government annually confers this award to individuals who have made significant contributions to Indian music.
 
• Kumar Sanu is celebrated for his melodious voice and has sung thousands of songs in various Indian languages, earning him multiple accolades including the Filmfare Awards.
 
• His contribution to Indian music in the 1990s, particularly in Bollywood, is considered instrumental in shaping the industry’s musical landscape during that period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lata Mangeshkar Award**

 
 
• The award is named after the legendary singer **Lata Mangeshkar**, who is widely regarded as one of the greatest playback singers in Indian history.
 
• Instituted by the Madhya Pradesh government, the award aims to honor individuals who have significantly contributed to Indian music.
 
• Recipients of the award are selected based on their lifetime achievements and contributions to the music industry.
 
 
 
• **Kumar Sanu’s Legacy**
 
 
• Kumar Sanu holds the Guinness World Record for singing the maximum number of songs (28) in a single day.
 
• He has won the **Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer** five consecutive times from 1991 to 1995.
 
• His evergreen hits include songs from movies like **Aashiqui, Baazigar, Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge**, and many more.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Music Awards**
 
 
• Music awards play a vital role in encouraging artists and preserving cultural heritage.
 
• They provide recognition to artists who have made outstanding contributions to the music industry.
 
• Such awards also serve to inspire young and upcoming musicians to strive for excellence.
